note: Single lock file. Each section is the unchanged content of the former file named in 'merged_from'. Update a section only for an explicitly user-approved change, then run verify_release.py.

baseline.policy: Do not update locked hashes or rules unless the user explicitly approves changing that protected behavior.

japan_rule.input_model: First page already displays +; user enters international digits. Japan numbers must start with 81.
japan_rule.meaning_of_zero_tolerance: 0 is international mobile part; 1 is normal domestic trunk 0; 2-3 tolerate up to two extra leading zeroes.

phone_validation.canonical_output: Use libphonenumber PhoneNumber.isValid() when available and return PhoneNumber.number without +, so domestic trunk zeroes after the calling code are removed from E.164 output.

scenario1_transit_copy.zh:
您好：這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦公室。

由於您的寄艙行李未能通過桃園機場的轉機X 光安全檢查。因此，您的行李目前暫時留在
轉機行李檢查處，未能安排裝載上機。

為了確保您的行李可以在航班起飛前順利完成檢查並安排裝載，麻煩您盡快返回登機閘口聯繫國泰航空職員，我們會協助您跟進。

多謝您的理解和配合
scenario1_transit_copy.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Your checked baggage did not pass the transfer X-ray security screening and is currently being held at the screening area.

Please return to the boarding gate as soon as possible and contact our staff for assistance, so we can arrange for your baggage to be loaded before departure.

Thank you for your cooperation.

layout.policy: Approved page structure and field placement are immutable. Do not change protected screen HTML, screen order, application chrome, or field/control order unless the user explicitly authorizes a layout change. Authorized SEC layout: Scenario 1 Join/Transit keeps the inline IATA-prefix + SEC-number field. Scenario 2 Final Call SEC page is intentionally removed for both Join and Transit. Authorized progress update: all progress text uses 20px/700; Scenario 1/2 progress uses “Flow - N/N - Passenger Type” after Passenger Type selection; before selection it uses “Flow - N/N”. Authorized responsive adjustment: keyboard-open mode may change Safe Area spacing and vertical workspace distribution, while protected screen/chrome markup and field/control order remain immutable. Authorized message-preview update: Message Preview is read-only on all message paths; Edit and Copy Text controls are removed. Authorized final visual tuning: preview language-order labels use 18px/700; progress counts use a lighter gray-green while retaining 20px/700. Scenario 3 step 2/4 Bag Tag 1 is restored to its prior stacked layout. Scenario 3 step 4/4 Confirm details places “無人領取的行李” immediately left of the Bag Tag 1 number at 18px/700. Confirm-details SEC displays IATA and SEC with visual spacing, and “Proceed to Gate” is renamed “Go to Gate”. These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized Passenger Type hierarchy: in Scenario 1 and Scenario 2, Join Pax & Message is the large primary option; Transit Pax & Message and Call Directly are smaller secondary options beneath it. Authorized progress compaction: numeric progress is displayed without spaces around the slash (for example 1/4). These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized Scenario 4 layout change: Flight Type is step 1/6 and uses the Passenger Type visual hierarchy; Tight Connection is the large primary choice, with Delayed and To be updated as the two smaller choices below. Authorized Scenario 4 follow-up: Flight Type remains step 1/6 but now behaves exactly like a Passenger Type choice page: its heading uses the default Passenger Type placement and it has no footer/Next. The delayed-time control is moved from Flight Type to Disrupted flight step 2/6, where it appears only for Delayed. Tight Connection and To be updated do not show that control. These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized label change (user-approved 2026-09-23): Scenario 4 Flight Type third option is renamed from “To be updated” to “Suspended”; s-dstatus is locked again with this label. Authorized layout change (user-approved 2026-09-23): Scenario 4 step 2/6 title is the single line “Flight from TPE” and the TPE chip is removed; s-dflight is locked again with this structure. Authorized release-label rename: visible release identity changed from r41 to R1; no other protected s-phone structure changed.

navigation.policy: Scenario step counts, progress display/order, step order, entry routing, and Passenger Type routing are immutable unless explicitly authorized. Scenario 1 Passenger Type is locked as progress step 1/3. Scenario 2 Final Call has no SEC page and is locked to 4 steps. Scenario 1/2 selected Passenger Type is a trailing annotation after the numeric progress. When Back returns to Passenger Type, the selected Passenger Type annotation is hidden on that page. Call Directly is a separate one-page branch and displays 1/1 on its Confirm details page. Browser history navigation is state-position aware: Back and Forward restore the corresponding screen rather than treating every popstate as Back. Authorized Scenario 4 behavior: Flight Type is step 1/6 and behaves like Passenger Type — no footer/Next; tapping Tight Connection, Delayed, or To be updated immediately opens step 2/6. Delayed time is not part of Flight Type; it is displayed and validated only on Disrupted flight step 2/6 when Delayed is selected. To be updated and Tight Connection never depend on delayed time. Flight Type title uses the same default heading placement as Passenger Type. Flight Type header follows Passenger Type as well: the phone-number pill is hidden on this choice screen. The remaining Scenario 4 steps retain their order through 6/6. Authorized label change (user-approved 2026-09-23): Scenario 4 Flight Type option “To be updated” is renamed “Suspended”; routing to status “unknown” is unchanged.
